title: rumohra arisanica
intro: Rumohra arisanica, commonly known as the Himalayan maidenhair fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known to possess several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra arisanica include its ability to act as an anti-anxiety agent, a bronchodilator, and a sedative, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions such as insomnia, anxiety disorders, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Rumohra arisanica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
